Name: (Content Patcher) Dragon Age Solas Replacer for Elliott
Author: darbylou
Description:
[font=Arial][size=4][font=Arial][size=4][color=#980000]
[/color][/size][color=#fff2cc][size=5][b][i][u]To install[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b] just unzip this mod into your Mods folder where your Stardew game is located!  [/b][/size][/color][size=4]
[/size][/font]

This mod add Solas into Stardew by replacing, yepp, you guessed it. Elliott! It changes most dialogue to fit Solas' character changes his sprites/ portraits and his cabin (with new descriptions for the things in the cabin) Currently the gift interests are the same as Elliotts, but i may change this in time!

The town NPC'S may mention Solas as "Elliott" instead of Solas bc I am not quite sure how to approach making that work.
I do not currently know what incompatibilities this mod has with others if any, aside from other mods that change anything about Elliott!

This mod requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]![/size][size=4]

[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=5][i][b]Currently only available in English, but will update this when/if translations are available! <33[/b][/i][b]

[color=#f4cccc]This hasnt been fully tested but very little should be bugged and i want to get [i]something[/i] out at the very least and update it overtime because its stressing me out. So just keep that in mind! [/color][/b][i]
I dont know how to make this work with vortex, if at all? lol[/i]
[b]
[/b]Please leave a comment me know if you found something wrong or have suggestions for this mod! I will get to things when/if I can!
